incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: streaming-decode-gpu-oom (severity P1) — elevated request drops and CUDA OOMs on decode nodes in us-west-2, paging on-call
oncall-ryan: on it, paging team, grabbing context. any customer-facing impact yet?
eng-runtime-alex: seeing lots of repeated "CUDA out of memory" from decode-worker-3/4. trace looks like sessions that never end (continuous token generation). suspect header parsing mismatch for client max_tokens guardrail.
infra-kate: routing shows surge from a few long-lived connections hitting sustained token churn on node pool decode-v2-gpu. QPS not huge but per-request tokens explode.
eng-sre-jamie: logs snippet: ```
E CUDA: out of memory while allocating 256MB at decode_stream.cpp:421
W session: session_id=abc123 tokens_generated=1_200_000 duration=02:15:32
```
oncall-ryan: possible misconfig source? recent deploys to router or SDK? @eng-runtime-alex any config flags that could disable max_token enforcement?
eng-runtime-alex: we rolled a router config yesterday that moved max_tokens enforcement to a sidecar service for performance — sidecar dropped a default when header missing. looks like client SDK set header "max_output_tokens": 0 in some SDK versions which we treat as "no limit". that's the token-spiral. reproducing locally now.
infra-kate: mitigation idea: enable per-connection soft cap in proxy (quick), and eject sessions exceeding 10k tokens. can push a hotpatch to edge to cut waste.
oncall-ryan: do it. also throttling upstream traffic for affected customer(s). notify support.
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy/edge hotpatch -> enable soft_token_cap=10000 (canary on edge-9 -> 10 -> all).
eng-sre-jamie: adding immediate fallback: route streaming decode to smaller model instance with strict token cap if node memory >80%. config snippet applied: ```json
{
  "stream_policy": "token_cap_fallback",
  "token_cap": 10000
}
```
cust-success-maya: FYI customer-42 reports partial response drops since 14:20 PST. opened ticket INC-2147 and escalated to on-call. they saw abrupt disconnects and retries.
oncall-ryan: status update: hotpatch canary on edge-9 succeeded, edge-10 rollout started. memory on decode nodes trending down as we eject long sessions. request drops reduced but customer retries still visible.
eng-runtime-alex: root cause draft: SDK/clients sending max_output_tokens=0 combined with router-side change that treated 0 as unlimited. server-side guardrail disabled by sidecar regression. leads to unbounded generation and GPU OOM.
infra-kate: manual mitigation steps taken: 1) enable proxy soft cap, 2) eject sessions >10k tokens, 3) redirect new streaming requests to cpu-decode pool for affected customers, 4) scale out decode-v2-gpu by +2 nodes as buffer.
eng-sre-jamie: handoff: @eng-sre-jamie taking lead for containment and postmortem. @eng-runtime-alex to prepare code fix to treat 0 as invalid and fall back to default cap. timeline: aim for patch in 2 hours then canary.
oncall-ryan: paging handoff acknowledged. I'll prep customer comms with cust-success-maya.
cust-success-maya: sending proactive note to customer-42: short blurb, root cause under investigation, mitigation in place, ETA for stable fix ~3h.
eng-runtime-alex: quick hotfix pushed to router-side: treat 0 as missing -> default_max_output_tokens=512. will roll canary after approvals. deploy-bot: router hotfix canary started.
eng-sre-jamie: monitoring: p99 latency back to normal, OOM errors falling to baseline. still watching for residual retries and token-leak sessions.
oncall-ryan: immediate customer impact: limited to 3 customers (IDs provided to CS). no broad SLA breach expected if containment holds.
eng-runtime-alex: follow-ups: write regression test for max token header parsing, add alert for sustained per-session token count > threshold, and add a circuit breaker that forcibly closes sessions at 50k tokens.
eng-sre-jamie: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime; severity P1 -> postmortem within 72h, include timeline, fix, and rollout plan.
cust-success-maya: logged customer updates in ticket INC-2147 and will follow up after fix is fully rolled.
oncall-ryan: closing on-call shift handed to eng-sre-jamie. thanks all for quick containment. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate reduced, customer impact limited to a small set. tag: postmortem-required.
